summary.text: Alexander Kolodin is the Republican nominee, a state representative and attorney. He sponsored a voter-ID bill that will be decided by voters on the November ballot, and his campaign says he would bring transparency and accountability to the Secretary of State's office.

paragraphs.text: Bachelor's degree from Georgetown University and law degree from the University of Pennsylvania; practiced law privately before elected office.
Member of the Arizona House of Representatives, District 3, since 2023.

sources.title: Kolodin wins Republican primary for Arizona secretary of state
